# WildWooHoo

> A creative innovation studio in Sydney that turns peer-reviewed research into pop music, films, books and school workshops, across the natural world and the technologies we build. Founded by Dr WELI, AAAS Dance Your PhD Overall Winner 2024. Coiner of the term "sci pop".
